description: Sec-WebSocket-Accept for a client's Sec-WebSocket-Key (RFC 6455 section 4.2.2, HK-235): the standard base64 (with = padding) of the SHA-1 digest of the key's UTF-8 bytes followed by the GUID 258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11. The key is hashed as given (the handshake trims it first, handshake.json); it is never checked as base64 or for length. The lengths around 55, 56 and 64 bytes cover SHA-1's padding.
function: protocol::handshake::accept_key (Swift: CoreBridge.acceptKey(forClientKey:); until slice 2.6 WebSocketFraming.acceptKey(forClientKey:)) — input the key, expected the accept value
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.7, v2.15; RFC 6455; Tests/PowerUpTests/ProtocolFixtureTests.swift testAcceptKeyTable plays it through the bridge (CoreBridge.acceptKey(forClientKey:)). Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/protocol.rs accept_key_cases runs protocol::handshake::accept_key.
capturedAgainst: Swift 5.9.2 Foundation and CryptoKit (Xcode 15.2) on macOS 27.2, PowerUp at 2d20afb

cases.name: the RFC 6455 sample key
cases.reason: The worked example of RFC 6455 section 1.3 (HK-235).

cases.name: an empty key
cases.reason: The handshake never hashes an empty key, but the function is total.

cases.name: a one-character key
cases.reason: The key is not checked as base64.

cases.name: a key with spaces inside
cases.reason: Inner spaces are part of the key.

cases.name: a key with padding inside
cases.reason: The key is hashed as text.

cases.name: a non-ASCII key
cases.reason: The key's UTF-8 bytes are hashed.

cases.name: a 19-byte key
cases.reason: SHA-1 padding: key plus GUID is 55 bytes: the padding fits one SHA-1 block.

cases.name: a 20-byte key
cases.reason: SHA-1 padding: key plus GUID is 56 bytes: the length spills into a second block.

cases.name: a 27-byte key
cases.reason: SHA-1 padding: key plus GUID is 63 bytes.

cases.name: a 28-byte key
cases.reason: SHA-1 padding: key plus GUID is exactly one 64-byte block.

cases.name: a 29-byte key
cases.reason: SHA-1 padding: key plus GUID is 65 bytes.

cases.name: a 83-byte key
cases.reason: SHA-1 padding: key plus GUID is 119 bytes: padding fits the second block.

cases.name: a 84-byte key
cases.reason: SHA-1 padding: key plus GUID is 120 bytes: the length spills into a third block.

cases.name: a 92-byte key
cases.reason: SHA-1 padding: key plus GUID is exactly two blocks.

cases.name: a 1000-byte key
cases.reason: SHA-1 padding: a long key across many blocks.
